description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for three distinct models: the 3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis is labeled 'Cost,' ranging from 0 to 10 with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis is labeled 'Reliability Score,' spanning from 30 to 90 with tick marks at intervals of 10. The 3-Model Ensemble is represented by a blue line with circular markers and a solid line, starting at a reliability score of approximately 85 at a cost of 0 and decreasing steadily to approximately 75 at a cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble is represented by a red line with circular markers and a solid line, beginning at a reliability score of approximately 88 at a cost of 0 and declining more sharply than the 3-Model Ensemble to approximately 70 at a cost of 10. The GPT-4 model is represented by a yellow line with circular markers and a solid line, starting at a reliability score of 90 at a cost of 0 and showing the most pronounced decline, falling to approximately 50 at a cost of 10.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for three distinct models: the 3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4. The x-axis is labeled 'Cost,' ranging from 0 to 10, while the y-axis is labeled 'Reliability Score,' spanning 30 to 90. The 3-Model Ensemble (blue line) begins at approximately 85 reliability at a cost of 0 and decreases steadily to around 75 at a cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble (red line) starts at roughly 88 reliability and exhibits a sharper decline, reaching approximately 70 at a cost of 10. GPT-4 (yellow line) begins at 90 reliability but shows the most pronounced drop, falling to approximately 50 at a cost of 10. Notably, the 2-Model Ensemble consistently outperforms the 3-Model Ensemble across all cost levels, while GPT-4 demonstrates a rapid decline in reliability after a cost of 2, intersecting the ensemble models at higher costs.
